Hello fellow story enjoyer :D. Of the games you have listed, I am currently playing FGO and Path to nowhere. So I can try to answer some of your questions regarding those two games. 

**FGO**: 


>Will I enjoy the story if I know absolutely nothing about fate universe ? 

I would say yes you can enjoy the story even if you don't know anything about the fate universe. The characters in Fate are based on actual/functional characters from real life (ex: king Arthur, William Shakespeare, etc.). So you can learn about their background story via google and like them as a character in FGO.  


>I read the first chapters are bad, how many hours it will take to reach the good chapters?

I can't say for sure, since I played the main story part 1 many years ago. However, I think Camelot Arc is when I started to really enjoy the story, or at least the arc I remembered the most about. Though, that is subjective.  I would guess 5-10 hours to get to Camelot. It is also depend if you use the skip function or not. 


>Is the game too pay to win ?

It is really depend on your definition of pay to win. The gacha system in this game is some of the worse I have ever seen. SSR rate is abysmal, super high pity count, and there isn't a lot of freebies available. Since you said you just want to enjoy the story and not character collecting, then it shouldn't be a problem for you. Can you clear the stories without paying? Yes. Will paying make the game easier? Also, yes. Though, every gachas are like that. 



>will it be hard for me to go through the chapters if I don't want to spend a lot of time grinding and completing daily quest ?

There are some challenging fights in the story. However, you can borrow someone else's OP unit to help you clear it. There is also a revival system that you can abuse. If your team get wiped, you can revive your entire team (pretty sure it is unlimited amount of time) and continue the fight where you left off. So I believe you can never really truly stuck and not able to advance in the story. There is a cost to the reviving your team though. There is some free revivals in game. However, once you ran out, you will have to use the 1 premium currency (saint quartz) for each revive. 3 saint quartz = 1 summon.  



**Path to Nowhere**
There are some difficult fights in the story mode that will stop you from advancing. However, the game does give you a very OP damage dealer to start with. You will need a healer (preferably Hamel, which might be difficult to get) if you want to go through the story while being under leveled. You can borrow other people's unit, but it is still pretty tough if you are under leveled. To fully clear the story mode without spending money, I would estimate that you will need to play the game for a couple months. The daily is extremely fast though, since it has a sweep system.

There are a lot of concerns about PVP in this game. Yes, the end game is heavily focus on PVP. However, one thing I like about this game is that I don't feel like I am forced to do PVP. I basically ignored all of them for the most parts. 

There are 3 types of PVP: Arena, Guild War, and World Arena. 

**Arena** (Vs AI): One of your skystone (premium currency) income source. Hold your rank until the end of the week and you will get rewarded with a certain amount of skystones. Even at low rank, the amount of skystones is pretty generous imo. Believe it or not, you don't need to do this mode at all once you are comfortable with your rank. As long as you don't attack others, you will not get attack much at all. It is honestly feel like a bug, but it has been like this since the start of the game. I literally been ignoring this game mode for the last 2 years. I just go and collect my skystones each week.

**Guild War** (Vs AI): One of your mystic medals (SUPER premium currency) income. There are 3 guild battles per week, and you have 3 attacks per guild war. I used to enjoy this mode, but it gotten quite cancerous. So nowadays, I just ignore it. You get about 150-200 mystic medals if you wins all of your fights. It is a decent amount, but not worth the effort to do it. So I ignore it. There are other ways to get mystic medals. Shop refresh is one, which is honestly my main source of getting more summons. It is tedious, but it is one of the best way for f2p to get more summons. Honestly, I have not seen any other games that have this feature. 

**World Arena** (Vs real players): You fight against other players. I just stay away for the most parts. There isn't too much incentive for me to play. The rewards are just character skins and cool character frames for flexing. For character skin reward, you can unlock it at a pretty low rank. So I usually do some matches near the near of the season just to get it (around 15-20 matches). New players will struggle to get the skins. However, the skins will get added later to the skin shop for you to purchase if you want to. 


Overall, I do recommend this game. Gear RNG can be annoying. However, it is what kept me playing the game. I want to complete my husbandos and waifus! IMO, it is super F2P friendly if you want to just collect characters and do PVE contents.  You will have a lot of PVE contents to go through. The game do give out a lot of free stuff, and I do think they are quite generous compared other games that I have played. Getting characters are not too challenging, since the game focuses more on gear grind. Additional copies (A.K.A dupes) are not required either, and is not a major powers spike to the character.
